hero.content: The **Gono Bishwabidyalay Journal of Research** is governed by an independent academic editorial board composed of senior faculty chairs, clinical experts, and international advisory scholars committed to objective double-blind evaluation and COPE publication ethics.

meta.noteText: Manuscript decisions are free from commercial, institutional, or political influence and are guided exclusively by independent peer reports.

pillars.title: Editorial Independence
pillars.subtitle: Merit-Based Outcomes
pillars.description: All manuscript decisions are made strictly on academic merit, research rigor, and peer review outcomes, without influence from commercial, institutional, or political interests.

pillars.title: COPE Code of Conduct
pillars.subtitle: Ethical Integrity
pillars.description: Our governance model strictly follows the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) guidelines for handling authorship disputes, conflict disclosures, and data integrity verification.

pillars.title: Double-Blind Review Integrity
pillars.subtitle: Objective Appraisal
pillars.description: Author identities and reviewer details remain completely concealed throughout the evaluation cycle, ensuring objective and impartial scholarly assessment.

pillars.title: Transparent Retractions & Appeals
pillars.subtitle: Accountable Record
pillars.description: Defined protocols for post-publication corrections, retractions, expressions of concern, and author appeal procedures maintain the highest standards of the scholarly record.

cta.content: We invite active researchers, faculty members, and clinical specialists across health sciences, pharmacy, agriculture, engineering, and social development to join our verified peer reviewer panel.

meta.contactText: Have questions regarding editorial nominations, special issues, or board governance? Contact the secretariat office directly.
